messages:
maria_partnerships: Hey team — kickoff for the cloud marketplace staging handoff. We need to confirm: 1) telemetry webhook for listings (GCP/AWS/Azure) 2) roles for publisher accounts 3) trial SKU visibility. Can we get a quick triage? 

sam_engineer: I'll own the telemetry webhook. Do we have a preferred endpoint and auth method? oauth vs shared secret? 

tina_pm: Prefer webhook with HMAC header + retry logic. We'll need event payloads for installs/activations and trial conversions. 

alex_ops: For AWS we'll need an IAM role for the publisher account and a cross-account trust from our staging tenant. I can draft the trust policy. 

maria_partnerships: @leo_legal any EULA/localization items to flag for the marketplace listing? Especially around trial data retention and telemetry collection. 

leo_legal: Yes — must add explicit consent language for telemetry + opt-out URL. Also note cross-border data transfer for EU customers; mention KMS usage for logs. I'll provide a snippet. 

sam_engineer: putting a quick sample HMAC header spec in case it's useful:

```
POST /webhook
Headers:
  X-Redwood-Signature: sha256=HEX(HMAC(secret, body))
```

Body: {"event":"install","sku":"trial-1000","customer_id":"..."}

alex_ops: For IAM, here's the minimal trust snippet I'll use (preview):

```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/MarketplacePublisher"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole"}
  ]
}
```

tina_pm: Can we flag per-cloud differences? GCP needs a service account key workflow; Azure needs managed identity + role assignment. Add those to the runbook. 

maria_partnerships: Action items: 
- @sam_engineer: implement webhook endpoint and tests (ephemeral secret + verify) 
- @alex_ops: create AWS trust role + instructions for publisher to attach 
- @tina_pm: update runbook with GCP/Azure steps and telemetry schema 
- @leo_legal: provide consent text and retention notes 

sam_engineer: I'll also add a middleware to de-duplicate events and surface retry status to the console. ETA EOD tomorrow. 

alex_ops: I'll post the role ARN and a minimal terraform snippet once created. 

infra-bot: Deploy check: webhook-staging service build succeeded (build-78). Smoke test URL: https://staging-api.redwood.ai/webhook/health — 200 OK :white_check_mark: 

leo_legal: Uploaded EULA draft to the drive, shared with partners. Please review before we submit listing. 

maria_partnerships: Thanks — once we have role ARNs, webhook tests green, and legal signoff we'll schedule publish window with AWS/GCP/Azure. Prefer Tuesday 9am PT. 

tina_pm: Agreed. I'll block calendar and create the checklist ticket. 

maria_partnerships: Great — closing this thread for now, keep updates in #partnerships. :rocket:
